messages:
ops_sam: Heads-up: vendor sent a note — H100/H200 split shipment delayed in FRA customs. They propose splitting: 6 H200 air (priority), remaining H100 sea + 4 H200 cold-chain sea. Need decision on whether we accept mixed manifest and who covers reclassification risk.

vendor_amy: Correct — customs raised HS-code question on H200 cooling assembly. If we want air for 6 H200 it's +$1.6k/unit including expedited clearance. Sea option is standard rate but adds 10d. We can switch invoice to include insurance at 40/60 (vendor/redwood) or vendor covers freight if you pay air surcharge.

claire_prod: Which regions impacted? Mainly eu-west-1 and ap-southeast edge pools. ap-southeast has only 3 spare H100s, so we should prioritize getting H200s to eu-west and keep some H100s for APAC.

infra_oli: Note: eu-west-1 currently has degraded NVLink on rack r5 — replacement H200s will be used for those nodes. If air only covers 6 units, sequence matters: replace r5 first then latency-critical racks. Depot cross-dock can take 12 crates on Wed morning slot.

finance_julie: Budget check: air 6 H200 = +9.6k surcharge + $2k duty prepay if vendor advances. We prefer vendor take 30% insurance but will accept 40/60 if vendor pushes docs. Need PO change and emergency approval code.

ops_sam: vendor_amy — can you confirm manifest will include original serials vs. temp IDs? We had issues before where returned serials didn't match RMA labels and depot rejected DOAs. Also need 5-day RMA booking SLA for DOAs.

vendor_amy: We'll include original serials on AWB and crate labels. Can add RMA preprinted labels and photo checklist. 5-day booking SLA is fine for air units; sea units will have 14-day SLA. AWB preview uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/XY7890.

infra_oli: Good. Please ensure crate power/foam spec on packing list (H200s require additional bracing). Depot confirmed thermal handling for H200 crates.

claire_prod: My recommendation: Air the 6 H200 to eu-west (cover NVLink racks), sea ship the H100 bulk + 4 H200 sea for APAC buffer. Accept 40/60 insurance split if vendor provides photo checklist and preprinted RMA labels. Ops to open surge-budget ticket.

finance_julie: ack on 40/60 if PO amendment includes vendor photo evidence clause and duty prepay line item. I'll start PO amendment.

ops_sam: Opening OPS ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4599. Scheduling maintenance windows for r5 racks Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will run canary replace of 1 H200 first.

vendor_amy: ack — updating manifest and invoice once PO amend done. We'll mark air AWB XY7890-01 and add RMA labels in crates.

logistics-bot: tracking note added to thread: carrier ETA Wed 06:00 UTC, customs docs pending.

ops_sam: thanks — reply with "ack" once tasks done.

finance_julie: ack — initiating PO amend.

infra_oli: ack — posting maintenance schedule to #eng-infra.

vendor_amy: ack — will post AWB and customs clearance receipt in thread when available.
